findings.detail: Issuer extraction is polluted by instrument and terms text; the raw SOI has a separate Portfolio Company cell, while the extracted issuer_name in the bundle is the full row string.

rationale: D06 failed with only 38/177 issuers persisting, but raw SOI rows show the same issuer persists across the 2025 and 2024 schedules when using the Portfolio Company cell. For example, Accela Inc/US appears in table 27 row 7 for 2025 and table 39 row 8 for 2024 with the same instrument and maturity. The bundle's extracted issuer_name is a concatenated full-row identifier rather than the source issuer cell, so rate and term changes break issuer continuity and make the low persistence metric a real extraction error.
